title: Immunity Mushroom Blend Powder
body:
Immune Support Meets Gut-Friendly Mushrooms

Our Fermented Mushroom Blend provides comprehensive immune and gut support with six functional mushrooms, fermented for optimal absorption and potency. Unlike raw mushroom powders, our blend uses a probiotic fermentation process to unlock powerful beta-glucans and immune-active polysaccharides, making them easier to digest and more bioavailable.

Each scoop combines Cordyceps, Reishi, Turkey Tail, Shiitake, Maitake, and Royal Sun mushrooms, all grown on organic oats and fermented for enhanced absorption. We pair this with natural vitamin C from acerola cherry and a prebiotic fiber blend featuring green tea extract and fermented ginger, making it a complete daily ritual for immune balance and digestive wellness.

🌿 Key Benefits

  • Immune system support with bioavailable beta-glucans*
  • Prebiotic fiber and antioxidants for gut + cellular health*
  • Fermented mushrooms for superior digestion and absorption
  • 100% vegan, allergen-free, and free of fillers or additives

Ingredients: Vitamin C, Organic Prebiotic Fiber Blend (Organic Inulin, Organic Green Tea Extract, Organic Fermented Ginger Root), Organic Immune Blend (Mushroom Mycelial Biomass Blend,[Cordyceps (Cordyceps militaris), Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum), Himematsutake (Royal Sun Agaricus) (Agaricus blazei), Shiitake (Lentinula edodes), Maitake (Grifola frondosa), Turkey Tails (Trametes versicolor)], Acerola Cherry Extract, Total Beta Flucan (from Organic Immune Blend), Organic Cassava Maltodextrin

100% Natural, Non-GMO, Gluten Free, Vegan, Lactose Free, Allergen Free, Hormone Free, Antibiotic Free, Corn Free, Vegetarian, No Fillers

Manufacturer Country: USA

Amount: 0.46lb (210g)

Gross Weight: 0.6lb (272g)

Suggested Use: Take one scoop daily mixed into food or drinks or as directed by a health professional.

Caution: Use only if seal is intact. Consult your health care practitioner if you are pregnant or nursing, taking medications, or have a medical condition, before taking this or any other product. Store in a cool, dry place. Keep out of reach of children.

Warning: This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
